extraction.Name: Eagan Lessert
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want the patent in fee to his 160 acre allotment, when it was issued, April 13, 1918, but he was informed that, if he did not take it, and pay the taxes, the land would be taxed just the same, and later sold for the taxes, so he accepted the patent
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: in 1923, he placed a mortgage on his 160 acres of land, in favor of A.L.Krause, of West Point, Nebraska, for $1500.00
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to A.L. Krause of West Point, Nebraska for $1500.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: part of this money being used to pay taxes, and part of it for improvements
extraction.Occupation/Income: ranches for his living; and that is the only source of income he has
extraction.NOTES: has a wife and two children to support, all of whom have good health; he has kept the taxes paid up on this land; has been keeping the payments and interest on this land paid up right along; has never sold his land for any debts incurred prior to receiving the patent in fee; has never received any help from the County, State nor the United States Government; document sworn March 11, 1929 | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
